scope: Presentation-only native single-file HTML sessions, evidence-derived header wording and scoped projection caching
supersedesImplementationOnly: The thumbnail-only HTML cards and inactive HTML teardown described in deliveries/native-knot-ui-20261114-summary.json are superseded. That historical report and its runtime evidence are unchanged.

html: Render the exact hash-verified Application Support original with loadFileURL and read access limited to its artifact directory.
Keep one retained live WKWebView per owner, conversation, bot and artifact, transferring the same view between inline and expanded hosts.
Use an isolated persistent WebKit profile per artifact; never use the default or Safari data store. Page-local storage can survive explicit Restart.
Do not reload or stop the page on an ordinary host unmount or scene-phase transition. Bound older detached sessions to three, in addition to the opened or attached sessions.
Provide explicit Restart of the same original; report WebKit content-process loss rather than silently replaying the page.
Install fail-closed content rules before file load, plus document-start CSP. Block remote resource connections, frames, forms, workers and downloads; expose no app message bridge.
Allow exact-original fragment navigation. Route only explicit safe external links through the existing browser/mail/phone policy without replacing the artifact.
Invalidate retained pages and release original-file pins at account, permission and deletion boundaries; persist profile-removal tombstones for retry.
Use a native live page host rather than an outer card Button. Ancestor gesture exclusion is implemented but has not been touch-accepted.
Leave original bundle export retrieval and non-HTML viewer branches in place; do not regenerate or seed deliveries.
headerAndPerformance: Derive planning/preparation wording from recorded selectionPhase, carrying it only within the newest matching request.
Require an explicit current source message before marking a task active; retain a blank idle header.
Cache step date ranges, stage wording and current-step projections; avoid repeated current-row sorting.
Cache cleaned message projections within the view context and update pill-only Events timelines without rebuilding all evidence steps.
Skip expensive header task projection while idle or without current ownership. Existing Events-only workspaceIncomplete narration is unchanged.
